meta.title: Famling · Tinglan / Selkirk Rex / Golden Retriever
meta.description: Shows a pixel mini pet (Tinglan, Selkirk Rex cat, Golden Retriever) below the DSH account area with no permanent buttons besides the character; right-click the pet (or press Shift+F10 / ContextMenu) to open a restrained hierarchical menu (chat / play / content & characters / settings / more), with submenu pages and full keyboard navigation. A role IS its theme bundle, so the content center is organized as Roles / Customize / Packs / Market; a unified settings popup centralizes every adjustable item and can enable an optional menu button (off by default). Content packs use the reserved v3 pure-data contract with a mandatory research-only declaration; no network, no script execution.
